name: image-viewer
description: View images and SVGs with numbered comments, freehand drawing and batch chat submission.

interface.shortDescription: Preview images, draw and comment directly.
interface.longDescription: Reusable image and SVG viewer with numbered pins, compact comment popups, freehand annotations, right-click batch comments and downloads. SVGs also include Code and Copy source. Each new image uses the same template with fresh comments.
